title: behavioros agent lists registered agents from the SQLite registry instead of only printing local state
timestampNote: Historical measuredAt values in this file were written in local time (UTC+1) with a Z suffix; host governance logs use UTC. The 2026-10-21 correction uses actual UTC. Results are unaffected.

environment.workingTree: changes uncommitted; no commit, push, tag, publish or deploy performed

before.implementation: packages/cli/src/cli.ts printed the .behavioros/state.json summary and a hard-coded 'use the SDK to register agents' message.
before.consequence: The command never read the engine's agents table, so it could not answer which agents were registered.
before.secondaryDefect: SqliteStore's constructor left the SQLite connection open when PRAGMA/migrate threw. On Windows the leaked handle made the corrupt database file impossible to remove or replace (observed as EPERM in the new regression test).

implementation: packages/cli/src/cli.ts: --db option; lists id, name, type/status, DNA pattern and current mission
packages/core/src/persistence/sqlite-store.ts: closes the handle before rethrowing a migration failure
after.exitCodes: 0 for a missing or empty registry; 1 when the registry exists but cannot be read (corrupt/locked database).
after.tests: 6 cases in packages/cli/tests/agents.test.ts + 1 case in packages/core/tests/sqlite-store.test.ts

cliCases: missing registry is reported without throwing
engine-persisted agents are listed ordered by id
a .behavioros/behavioros.db registry is found when the root database is absent
an explicit --db path is honoured even when missing
a corrupt database is reported as an error, not as an empty registry
a valid empty registry returns an empty list
regressionProof.coreCase: A failed migration throws and the database file can be removed immediately afterwards; the same assertion fails with the previous leaked handle on Windows.

cases: registered agent: exit 0; output includes 'agent-1  DevBot  [developer/idle]  DNA=open-source  mission=none' and '1 registered agent(s)'
no registry: exit 0; output includes 'No agent registry found'
corrupt registry: exit 1; output includes 'Could not read the registry: file is not a database'

limitations: The registry is the engine's SQLite `agents` table. The OpenCode plugin's ctx.storage snapshot has no agents field and is not read by this command.
The command is read-only; registration still happens through the SDK/engine registerAgent API.
A missing registry and an empty registry are both exit 0 by design; the distinction is the message.
A corrupt database is reported and exits 1, but the CLI does not attempt repair.
Docker is not installed in this environment, so the container image was not built or run.
Release automation remains human-gated and unverified; no commit, push, tag, publish or deploy was performed.

corrections.corrected: opens the registry with SqliteStore, which uses a read-write SQLite connection, runs idempotent migrations and may create WAL/SHM files; the command does not write domain data but requires directory write access.
corrections.reason: DatabaseSync is opened read-write and the constructor runs PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL plus migrate(). The listing itself only reads agents.
